PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

3. When learning Computer Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Concepts.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Concepts.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Concepts.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Concepts.

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

6. When learning Introduction to Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Drawing.

7. When learning Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.

8. When learning Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.

9. When learning Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metallic Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metallic Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Metallic Materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials.

10. When learning Free-hand sketching, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Free-hand sketching.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Free-hand sketching.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Free-hand sketching.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Free-hand sketching.

11. When learning ICT Tools in Communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ICT Tools in Communication.
   B. Skip safety briefings for ICT Tools in Communication.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ICT Tools in Communication.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ICT Tools in Communication.

12. When learning Introduction to Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Materials.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in the Immediate Environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Concepts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Free-hand sketching and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
